policy.scope: Classical ML only, including classical preprocessing, metrics, model selection, matrix factorizations, graph/manifold estimators and classical forecasting. Excludes neural models, neural optimizers, transformers, Mamba, CNNs, language models and Apple FAST tuning.
policy.identity: Within EACH arm/version, NVIDIA, AMD, Apple and the host must produce bitwise-identical promised outputs/state. A and B may have different bits. Matching B's old bits is not a quality gate for a versioned profile. Each arm must independently satisfy task quality; compare every admitted model attribute, convergence/selection decision, error and seed contract.
policy.default: All new candidates default OFF; no promotion, merge to main, build, test, static verification, benchmark, remote job or board-result mutation in this request.
policy.performance: A future default decision requires full-dataset end-to-end A/B on both NVIDIA and AMD for every affected estimator and relevant interaction, combined faster with neither materially slower; Apple/host establish identity and Apple times do not vote. One excluded warmup and one scored sample, serial cells per GPU, separate vendor boxes. Reuse accepted matching build/identity evidence.
policy.workload: Resolve dataset version/hash/split, actual dimensions, settings, numeric profile, flags and timed boundaries before any future timing. Audit intrinsic lane caps; --rows full is not proof. Missing mappings remain pending. Fit/preparation/synchronization/consumed outputs are included; cold, repeated use and inference are separate.
policy.routing: No exact benchmark dimensions, names, seeds or adjacent-to-board thresholds. Explain every route using hardware/work/bytes and cover neighboring shapes and one non-board dataset. For removing a targeted incumbent rule, A is the general rule and B explicitly retains the old rule.
policy.implementation: Mojo performs all runtime data processing. Python here is metadata/orchestration only. Use supported Mojo facilities; record upstream asks and park unsupported functionality. No compiler-output edits, unsupported build modes or speculative backend shims.
policy.resources: Any future CPU race gets all allocated cores (actual Linux cgroup allocation; Apple unrestricted), arms serially, preserving algorithm semantics and documented nested pools. Record worker effective pools.
policy.evidence: Retain winners, losers, neutral/inconclusive cells, refusals and pending cells with source/binary/harness/hardware provenance. Use board tools only when real measurements exist. No opponent ratio from own-only A/B. A source draft is not a compile pass, identity proof, quality pass, speed win or complete full-workload harness.

workload_recipe_sources.more: tools/bench_board_more.py: LANES, LANE_CONFIG, preparation and workload constants
workload_recipe_sources.expanded: tools/bench_board_algos.py: LANES, _add calls, sub/block definitions, settings and timed spans (classical lanes only)

C03/C04/C05/C08 × all affected estimators: input preparation, scratch retention and data ownership; include cold/repeated fit.
C06/C29/C30/C32/C36: norms, direct/expanded distances, selection and threshold fusion; ensure metric route reach.
C07/C08/C10/C12/C31: shared sort/scan storage and canonical key contracts; avoid unbounded combined scratch.
C13/C14/C15/C18/C23/C24: CV statistics, factorization and solve profile; selected model can change only with preserved quality.
C16/C17/C19: objective fusion, independent trials and persistent updates; never speculate dependent SGD samples.
C20/C21/C22: SVM cache, extrema and symmetric kernels; check complete trajectory and memory together.
C29/C31/C32/C33/C34/C43/C44: graph membership/order, convergence, hierarchy and manifold quality.
C36/C37/C38/C39: KMeans assignment, centroid fold, initialization and state retention; full-fit acceptance.
C02/C04/C14/C23/C53/C54/C55/C56/C57: covariance/factor consumers and their uncertainty/quality outputs.
C58/C59/C60: shared forecasting preparation, candidate batching and order selection.

experiments.title: Versioned fixed-leaf reduction profiles
experiments.arm_a: A new classical-only logical leaf size and adjacent-pair merge, independent of physical block and warp size. Separate leaf sizes into separate arms.
experiments.arm_b: The incumbent caller's specified serial/halving reduction.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: New version: fix leaf membership, per-leaf addition/FMA order, FTZ, odd-tail carry and signed zero; use one scalar helper in host and device. GPU geometry may schedule but never redefine leaves.
experiments.quality_gate: Objective, residual and downstream task metrics must not degrade; inspect cancellation, overflow, subnormals, constant and ragged columns.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject register spills, larger scratch, poor error growth or any incomplete host/caller migration; no global neural-mode change.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: I04 proposes a GEMM fold revision; this is a classical scalar-statistic profile, separately gated.

experiments.title: Fuse independent column statistics with shared input loads
experiments.arm_a: Calculate independent sums/counts or centered second moments in a single tiled read, maintaining separate accumulators and the incumbent order for each output.
experiments.arm_b: Separate passes over identical input for each statistic.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Keep two-pass centered variance where required; merging passes is not permission to replace it with E[x²]-E[x]².
experiments.quality_gate: Every fitted mean, variance, scale, count and downstream output; zero-variance, weighted and missing-data semantics.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject increased spills or occupancy loss, duplicated reads on tails, and any changed missing-value denominator.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: I24 leaves broader preprocessing pass fusion open.

experiments.title: Fuse finite checks and extrema production
experiments.arm_a: Produce validity status and required extrema from one input walk, with canonical first-error indexing.
experiments.arm_b: Separate validity and extrema scans.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Exact status/min/max selections use an explicit total order and original public NaN/Inf refusal rules; publication still waits for validation.
experiments.quality_gate: Same refusal type/index, fitted extrema, signed zeros, empty-input and all-missing behavior.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject early mutation before a deferred error or any policy that silently drops nonfinite rows.

experiments.title: Apply centering and scaling at the consumer load
experiments.arm_a: Pass immutable mean/scale buffers to a Mojo consumer and reproduce subtract/divide operations at load, avoiding an intermediate matrix.
experiments.arm_b: Materialize centered/scaled input and then read it in the consumer.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Keep the stored-intermediate rounding and FTZ seams explicit even when no matrix is stored; do not contract subtraction and multiplication into an FMA.
experiments.quality_gate: Fitted state, predictions, residuals and input ownership; readonly, strided and repeated callers.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject recomputation when multiple consumers make materialization cheaper; report cold and repeated use separately.

experiments.title: Retain bounded classical scratch across phases
experiments.arm_a: Reuse explicitly owned scratch sized from live bytes for sequential stages; separate retained fit scratch from optional repeated-call caches.
experiments.arm_b: Allocate and release each temporary at each phase/call.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Scheduling only: initialize every consumed cell and preserve device/context ownership, asynchronous lifetime, error release and concurrent estimator isolation.
experiments.quality_gate: Same outputs, failures and repeated-fit state; cover growing/shrinking shapes and context changes.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject unbounded retention, stale-data dependence or a cold-use regression hidden by hot timings.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: I02 covers GEMM scratch; extend only to classical caller-owned buffers.

experiments.title: Batch row norms without changing feature folds
experiments.arm_a: Assign multiple independent rows to one block or tile, reusing dispatch and coalesced loads with each row's logical lanes unchanged.
experiments.arm_b: One incumbent row task per block.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Feature order, squared terms, pinned fold and portable square root remain fixed; schedule choices follow bytes and available parallelism, not benchmark dimensions.
experiments.quality_gate: Norm and final distance words, underflow, overflow, signed zero, tails and downstream task quality.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject reduced parallelism, shared-memory expansion or accidental use of physical warp width.

experiments.title: Stable radix layout for classical preparation
experiments.arm_a: Independently vary digit width, keys per task, and ragged-segment bucket scheduling under a scratch/shared-memory cost model.
experiments.arm_b: Incumbent stable radix schedule with identical key encoding.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Stable secondary row index, NaN policy, signed-zero ordering and per-segment boundaries are preserved; no approximate quantiles.
experiments.quality_gate: Exact permutations, category IDs, quantile cutpoints and public transforms; duplicates and highly skewed segments.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject descriptors or histogram clears costing more than passes saved; do not rerun a previously decided identical configuration.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Reuse I19 infrastructure and distinguish new geometries from existing digit-width arms.

experiments.title: Reuse category dictionaries and inverse maps
experiments.arm_a: Build a canonical dictionary and inverse map once per fit, then share them among counts and encodings; evaluate independent grouped output emission.
experiments.arm_b: Repeated dictionary/sort/inverse work for each consumer.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: No dictionary reordering; unknown/missing-category behavior and supervised fold isolation remain unchanged.
experiments.quality_gate: Vocabulary, inverse map, output shape/layout and target-encoding leakage guards; unseen labels and repeated fits.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject cache keys based only on pointer address or shape; no reuse across mutated data without an explicit immutable owner.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: I19 supplies dictionary primitives; this card concerns caller lifetime and reuse.

experiments.title: Fused regression and weighted metric reports
experiments.arm_a: Share prediction/target loads while maintaining one pinned accumulator stream per metric; finish a requested metric bundle with one status/readback boundary.
experiments.arm_b: Separate public metric calls or separate native passes.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: No reassociation between metrics; denominator, multioutput policy, force-finite and zero-weight rules are part of the contract.
experiments.quality_gate: All requested values and warning/error states; degenerate targets and large weight range.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject extra unrequested work or an API that times a smaller output set than the control.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: I24 combines classification reports; extend to regression.

experiments.title: Reuse stable score sorting for ranking metrics
experiments.arm_a: Compute a single stable score order and tie boundaries, then emit all requested rank metrics from shared canonical prefix counts.
experiments.arm_b: Each metric sorts and scans independently.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Tie blocks, positive-label encoding, weights and threshold endpoint conventions remain exact; weighted prefixes keep a fixed arithmetic tree.
experiments.quality_gate: Curves and scalar values for all ties, missing classes, weights and multiclass averaging.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject retained sorted state without input ownership or assumptions that tied scores can be permuted arbitrarily for weighted sums.

experiments.title: Generate resampling indices at their consumer
experiments.arm_a: Regenerate deterministic counter-indexed draws directly in gather/statistic tasks or retain one compact permutation for multiple consumers.
experiments.arm_b: Materialize full index arrays and reread them for each operation.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Seed, draw number, replicate, rejection sampling and ordering must produce the same sequence; stateful RNG cannot be replaced without a separately versioned contract.
experiments.quality_gate: Index sequence, multiplicities, confidence intervals and hypothesis-test statistic/p-value; no data-dependent RNG draw consumption.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject repeated RNG cost exceeding memory savings or altered dependence between replicates.

experiments.title: Sparse exact classification counts before dense output
experiments.arm_a: Accumulate exact integer occupied label-pair counts in canonical sorted segments, then materialize the requested dense or sparse report once.
experiments.arm_b: Clear and update a full class-by-class scratch table for each report.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Unweighted integer counts only in the first arm; weighted FP counts need a separate fixed-fold profile. Public class ordering and empty cells are unchanged.
experiments.quality_gate: All confusion and averaging outputs, absent classes, high class counts, integer overflow/refusal and warning cells.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject sort overhead for dense occupancy; route only from documented storage/work estimates and preserve public output allocation cost.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Build on I24 exact report APIs; this is occupied-key accumulation.

experiments.title: Shared sufficient statistics across CV folds
experiments.arm_a: Compute disjoint fold statistics once and combine the retained folds in a specified order for each training set; keep solver selection and fold IDs.
experiments.arm_b: Rescan every training fold independently.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: New version for all columns: per-fold means and centered Gram construction must have a complete host/device fold contract. Never assume total-minus-heldout has old bits.
experiments.quality_gate: Validation losses, selected alpha/C/l1 ratio, coefficients, convergence and ill-conditioned residuals; include leakage checks.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject cancellation, workspace inflation or fewer optimization iterations masquerading as a scheduling gain.

experiments.title: Reuse one factorization for multiple right-hand sides
experiments.arm_a: Factor once and apply the same canonical factor to grouped target/RHS columns with bounded workspace.
experiments.arm_b: Refactor or repeatedly reload identical factors for each RHS.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Same factor, pivot/rank decisions and solve folds; caches belong to immutable fitted state and include regularization/preprocessing settings.
experiments.quality_gate: Residuals, coefficients, rank, predictions and stale-factor invalidation; singular and nearly singular cases.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject memory growth or latency losses for a single RHS.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Reuse I22 factor-state work; extend actual multioutput callers without claiming new initial implementation.

experiments.title: Solve against factors instead of forming inverses
experiments.arm_a: Replace inverse-then-product with canonical triangular solves where the public operation does not need a dense inverse; retain separately requested uncertainty outputs.
experiments.arm_b: Materialize and multiply by an explicit inverse.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: New numerical profile across host and all devices, fixed solve ordering and pivot policy; do not replace required inverse-derived diagnostics with approximations.
experiments.quality_gate: Prediction, posterior variance/evidence, condition sensitivity and residuals at least as good as control.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject loss of required fitted attributes or worse uncertainty calibration.

experiments.title: Fuse GLM response, residual and objective production
experiments.arm_a: Reuse each linear response and portable nonlinear evaluation to produce residuals and loss leaves in one pass; preserve separate canonical objective fold.
experiments.arm_b: Separate response, nonlinear link, residual and objective kernels.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Same stable link branches, FMA boundaries, regularization and trial-vector association; line search sees exactly the intended candidate state.
experiments.quality_gate: Objective/gradient, first accepted step, convergence iterations, coefficients, probabilities and deviance.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject changed branch behavior at extreme logits or stale objective/gradient reuse.

experiments.title: Batch independent OVR and line-search tasks
experiments.arm_a: Schedule independent classes or explicitly materialized trial vectors together; independently attribute OVR and bounded speculative line search.
experiments.arm_b: Sequential dispatch of the same classes/trials.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Preserve first accepted trial, logical evaluation counts, class order and each model's iteration dependencies.
experiments.quality_gate: All fitted states, probabilities, accepted steps, refusals and convergence; count physical speculative work separately.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject extra evaluations or expanded live state erasing the launch savings.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Reuse I12 existing OVR and bounded4trial code; new work is full-caller selection/combination mapping.

experiments.title: Coordinate-descent residual tile reuse
experiments.arm_a: Keep one bounded feature/residual tile resident through adjacent ordered coordinate updates, or fuse residual write with its next ordered consumer.
experiments.arm_b: Separate residual update and next-coordinate scans.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Coordinate updates remain sequential in the declared order; simultaneous Jacobi updates are a different algorithm and excluded.
experiments.quality_gate: Duality gaps, stopping iteration, sparsity pattern, coefficients and predictions; correlated columns.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject changed residual rounding or silently weakened convergence tolerance.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: I12 independent-coordinate infrastructure is reusable; this card targets memory passes.

experiments.title: Persistent ordered online linear updates
experiments.arm_a: Run bounded consecutive samples in one device task with resident coefficients; reuse existing step-fusion where available and extend equivalent online solvers.
experiments.arm_b: One launch/dispatch boundary per logical update.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: No mini-batch averaging: retain exact sample permutation, learning-rate time index, clipping, penalties and sequential updates.
experiments.quality_gate: Coefficients, intercept, epochs, loss, averaging state and seeded repeatability.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject device watchdog pressure, lost parallelism or changed sample semantics.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: I12 supplies SGD fusion; do not duplicate its decided controls.

experiments.title: Bounded SVM kernel-row cache and shared pair loads
experiments.arm_a: Reuse canonical kernel rows across working-set updates with deterministic eviction, and fuse independent loads of selected row pairs.
experiments.arm_b: Recompute/reload kernel rows under incumbent cache organization.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Cache only computed values; working-set selection, row precision, gamma, exp, error updates and stopping remain identical.
experiments.quality_gate: Support vectors, dual coefficients, decision values, probabilities and iteration count; repeated rows and near ties.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject cache memory dominating fit or a hardware-specific eviction policy affecting arithmetic rather than storage.

experiments.title: Fuse canonical SMO extrema selection
experiments.arm_a: Compute multiple independent KKT extrema from one scan and reduce explicit value/index tuples together.
experiments.arm_b: Separate scans/reductions for each working-set statistic.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Exact total order with stable index ties, NaN refusals and eligibility masks; no heuristic working-set change.
experiments.quality_gate: Selected indices, KKT violations, full SMO trajectory and final model.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject altered ties or register pressure exceeding memory savings.

experiments.title: Produce symmetric Gram/kernel triangles once
experiments.arm_a: Evaluate one canonical orientation of each symmetric pair, then mirror once or let a triangular consumer read it.
experiments.arm_b: Compute both matrix halves independently.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: If current orientations differ in floating evaluation order, establish a versioned canonical orientation across all columns; keep diagonal and signed-zero semantics explicit.
experiments.quality_gate: Full matrix and downstream model state, symmetry, PSD/residual diagnostics and quality.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject triangular indexing overhead or assuming all configured kernels are symmetric.

experiments.title: Stream centered covariance for PCA and discriminants
experiments.arm_a: Accumulate explicitly centered fixed row panels and merge their covariance blocks in one versioned tree, avoiding a centered full matrix.
experiments.arm_b: Materialize centered data then call the incumbent covariance contraction.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: One panel partition and merge order on host/NVIDIA/AMD/Apple; preserve centering before products rather than unstable raw-moment subtraction.
experiments.quality_gate: Explained variance, orthogonality, reconstruction, rank, discriminant accuracy and conditioning.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject altered statistical normalization, inaccurate tail handling or quality loss.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Related to I22 blocked linalg, but a separate covariance numerical profile.

experiments.title: Versioned TSQR merge tree and panel sizes
experiments.arm_a: Compare binary and fixed higher-arity logical QR merge trees and panel widths as independent arithmetic profiles, with immutable column sign conventions.
experiments.arm_b: Current TSQR logical tree and panel profile.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: All columns must implement the identical reflector formation/application, pivot/rank and sign rules; vendor scheduling may differ only below this tree.
experiments.quality_gate: R/Q words across vendors, reconstruction/backward error, orthogonality, rank and downstream prediction quality.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject higher workspace, increased error or reliance on unsupported compiler features; no revival of quarantined block-Jacobi code.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Explicit unimplemented profile extension of I22.

experiments.title: Reuse randomized projection and decomposition panels
experiments.arm_a: Reuse immutable projection/basis tiles across outputs and fuse adjacent pointwise transforms without changing iteration count or rank.
experiments.arm_b: Reload or rematerialize the same projection/basis intermediates.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: RNG coordinate mapping, oversampling, power iterations, sign canonicalization and reduction order remain fixed.
experiments.quality_gate: Transform words, reconstruction/subspace quality, downstream scores and seeded model state.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject dropping power iterations or reducing embedding dimension to obtain the speed gain.

experiments.title: Reuse NMF sufficient products within each accepted step
experiments.arm_a: Cache WᵀW/WᵀX or HHᵀ/XHᵀ only while the corresponding factor is unchanged, fuse elementwise update/clamp passes with explicit rounding.
experiments.arm_b: Recompute products or materialize each update intermediate independently.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Same alternating update dependency, normalization, epsilon and zero-lock behavior; never reuse across a factor mutation.
experiments.quality_gate: Reconstruction error, objective trajectory, iterations and nonnegative fitted factors.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject stale products or a changed epsilon/tolerance/rank.

experiments.title: Batch independent ICA and factor-analysis component work
experiments.arm_a: Share centered input tiles across independent component score/nonlinearity calculations; batch independent solves and defer only redundant drains.
experiments.arm_b: Separate scans and temporary matrices for each component.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Preserve deflation dependencies, orthogonalization order and sign/tie conventions; only truly independent work can execute concurrently.
experiments.quality_gate: Convergence, reconstruction, component subspace, likelihood/correlation and predictions.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject altered deflation or an aggregate quality metric hiding a failed component.

experiments.title: Bucket independent sparse-coding and ALS solves
experiments.arm_a: Group independent row/item solves by nonzero count or active-set workspace and reuse a shared dictionary/Gram tile.
experiments.arm_b: One uniform task shape and repeated dictionary loads for all rows.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Stable row/nonzero order, identical regularization and canonical solves; scheduling changes cannot alter active-set ties or the ALS half-step barrier.
experiments.quality_gate: Objective, support, recommendation ranking and full factor state; empty and extremely long rows.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject sorting/descriptor cost, peak scratch or silently approximated solves.

experiments.title: Streaming exact distance-to-top-k
experiments.arm_a: Fuse distance tiles with local exact top-k and a bounded canonical merge, avoiding a full query-by-reference distance matrix.
experiments.arm_b: Materialize distances then select.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Exact (distance,index) total order, same metric arithmetic and self-neighbor policy. Approximate pruning is excluded unless independently certified with exact fallback.
experiments.quality_gate: Every neighbor/index/distance and downstream predictions or LOF score; large k, ties, duplicates and tails.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject merge overhead, oversized local lists or unproven exclusion bounds.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Reuse I15/A06 selection machinery; split new full-caller tile/merge arms from prior experiments.

experiments.title: Versioned direct-difference distance arithmetic
experiments.arm_a: Use fixed-fold sum((x-y)²) in bounded tiles, independently compare register lane counts with one logical arithmetic profile.
experiments.arm_b: Expanded ||x||²+||y||²-2x·y with the incumbent clamp.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: This deliberately changes version bits: subtraction, square/FMA, FTZ, fold and distance clamp must be identical in every column; metric semantics remain exact Euclidean.
experiments.quality_gate: Neighbor membership, cancellation-sensitive distances, clustering quality, densities and model metrics; nearly equal large vectors.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject degraded task quality, overflow behavior or replacing a configured metric.

experiments.title: Bucket ragged CSR canonicalization by work
experiments.arm_a: Compact row tasks by required merge levels/degree and schedule stable merges only for active runs.
experiments.arm_b: Uniform merge levels driven by the longest row.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Sort only; preserve membership, multiplicity, CSR offsets and stable neighbor index order.
experiments.quality_gate: Complete canonical CSR words and final cluster states; singleton, empty, huge and skewed rows.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject max-degree readback or descriptors erasing the gain.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Follow-up to I13 stable canonical merge, not its initial implementation.

experiments.title: Fuse exact radius threshold and compact emission
experiments.arm_a: Distance evaluation writes threshold flags/counts directly, then emits canonical accepted edges using bounded scans; attribute count-only and emit fusion separately.
experiments.arm_b: Write full distance tiles, then threshold and compact.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Same inclusive/exclusive threshold rule and portable distance arithmetic; emit sorted indices or retain canonicalization.
experiments.quality_gate: Exact edge sets, offsets, distances and boundary-equal cases plus DBSCAN output.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject duplicate distance evaluation costing more than traffic saved or a moved epsilon boundary.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Reuse N08; extend vendor-neutral caller integration.

experiments.title: Freeze first graph convergence state on device
experiments.arm_a: Queue a bounded chunk of iterations under a device live mask, preserving the first converged state and performing one status readback.
experiments.arm_b: Host polls after every iteration.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Frozen inactive state, first stopping iteration and canonical label assignment; later speculative rounds cannot modify converged buffers.
experiments.quality_gate: Labels, graph probabilities, stopping counts, long chains, disconnected and nearly converged graphs.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject excessive masked work or observing only the last round of a chunk.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Reuse I14 convergence machinery; include full graph callers and interactions.

experiments.title: Canonical parallel MST edge selection
experiments.arm_a: Reduce candidate edges in parallel with a total (weight,min_endpoint,max_endpoint) key and deterministically emit chosen edges/components.
experiments.arm_b: Incumbent repeated edge scans or serial canonical selection.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Mutual-reachability arithmetic and tie policy fixed; if tie contract changes, all model/host columns must move in one new version.
experiments.quality_gate: MST, condensation, cluster labels/probabilities, stability, prediction and outlier outputs.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject floating atomic ordering, disconnected-graph mishandling or claiming identical labels alone proves equivalent hierarchy.

experiments.title: IVF long-list chunking and short-list packing
experiments.arm_a: Split long selected lists into independent chunks and pack small ones, merging exact top-k results in canonical order.
experiments.arm_b: One fixed task per query/list.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Centroids, nprobe, list membership, distances, ties and index training unchanged; no reduced recall allowance.
experiments.quality_gate: Full search IDs/distances and declared recall, giant/empty lists and batch tails.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject task setup or merge cost and do not change nprobe to obtain speed.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Extend I16 scheduling with recorded scope; no duplication of already supplied staging arms.

experiments.title: Reuse KMeans centroid tiles through assignment
experiments.arm_a: Share centroid/norm tiles across multiple independent row assignments and fuse nearest-centroid selection with distances.
experiments.arm_b: Separate distance production and assignment selection with repeated centroid reads.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Keep canonical centroid index ties, incumbent feature folds, inertia and empty-cluster handling.
experiments.quality_gate: Labels, centers, inertia, iterations and initialization trajectories across multiple seeds.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject register pressure or different center assignment at near ties.

experiments.title: Versioned fixed-row centroid accumulation
experiments.arm_a: Accumulate row panels with fixed logical membership and a canonical merge; separate cluster-feature task geometry from the arithmetic partition.
experiments.arm_b: Current centroid sum accumulation profile.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: New profile only if logical row partition changes; host and all GPUs share partition, sample-weight multiplication and normalization order.
experiments.quality_gate: Centers, inertia and task quality with imbalanced/empty clusters, large weight ranges and cancellation.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject atomic floating sums, hardware-dependent leaves or a single-vendor win with material loss on the other.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: A08 tested a geometry candidate; reuse evidence only when source/profile actually match.

experiments.title: KMeans++ nearest-distance reuse
experiments.arm_a: Update the minimum-distance vector only against newly added centers and reuse candidate potential partials with bounded device status handling.
experiments.arm_b: Recompute distances against all chosen centers or drain each independent trial separately.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Same random draws, candidate order, potential fold, first minimum tie and selected centers.
experiments.quality_gate: Exact chosen seed centers and full fit quality; duplicates and exhausted nonzero distance mass.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject stale minimum vectors, altered random draw counts or speculative trials changing selection.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Existing incremental init/PSI switches need selective recipe coverage; do not reinvent them.

experiments.title: Retain mini-batch and bisecting clustering state
experiments.arm_a: Retain counts, center state, subset row IDs and statistics across ordered batches/splits in IDENTICAL Mojo paths.
experiments.arm_b: Repeated transfers, reconstruction or independent temporary allocation per batch/split.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Seed stream, batch membership/order, center reassignment, split priority and stopping remain fixed; FAST code is a reference for storage only.
experiments.quality_gate: Centers, labels, counts and batch/iteration histories; skewed and empty partitions.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject importing FAST arithmetic, state leakage or hidden batch-size changes.

experiments.title: Share MeanShift distance tiles across seed updates
experiments.arm_a: Batch independent live seeds with bounded distance tiles and ordered in-band sums; compact inactive seeds without changing their logical IDs.
experiments.arm_b: Per-seed scans with uniform work for completed seeds.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Bandwidth, inclusive boundary, update fold, stopping and final mode suppression/ties unchanged.
experiments.quality_gate: Centers, cluster assignment and convergence histories on uneven seed densities.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject changing bin seeding or bandwidth estimation sample counts.

experiments.title: OPTICS fused canonical reachability minima
experiments.arm_a: Fuse eligibility/reachability updates and compact minimum selection; reuse computed neighbor rows where immutable.
experiments.arm_b: Separate full scans and redundant neighbor calculations per expansion.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Expansion order, predecessor ties, core distances and Xi extraction must remain canonical; no approximate queue ordering.
experiments.quality_gate: Ordering, reachability, predecessor and extracted hierarchy/labels.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject task overhead or a change to the first equal-reachability row.

experiments.title: Compact active agglomerative distance work
experiments.arm_a: Store one canonical triangle and maintain deterministic active-cluster task lists while updating only affected distance rows.
experiments.arm_b: Scan/update full square workspaces including inactive entries.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Preserve linkage recurrence arithmetic, merge ties, cluster numbering and connectivity constraints.
experiments.quality_gate: Children, distances, cut labels and full dendrogram on equal-distance and disconnected cases.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject compaction costs or use of a nearest-neighbor-chain algorithm without proving the required tie contract.

experiments.title: Resident normalized graph operators
experiments.arm_a: Reuse CSR degree/normalization buffers and fuse pointwise scaling into fixed-fold sparse matvec consumers.
experiments.arm_b: Materialize normalized matrices and repeat host/device preparation or separate scaling passes.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Per-row neighbor order and reduction tree fixed; eigenvector sign/order, solver stopping and graph topology unchanged.
experiments.quality_gate: Residuals, embeddings/subspace quality, graph outputs and downstream labels; isolated and high-degree rows.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject changed eigen-solver tolerance or graph sparsification as a supposed scheduling optimization.

experiments.title: Seeded UMAP graph and sampling-state reuse
experiments.arm_a: Cache immutable canonical fuzzy-graph metadata and generate independent edge-sampling descriptors on device, reusing them across ordered optimization steps.
experiments.arm_b: Repeated metadata construction or transfer for the same graph/epoch.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Preserve RNG draw mapping, edge order, negative samples and dependent coordinate update order; parallel conflicting SGD updates are excluded.
experiments.quality_gate: Seeded embedding words, trustworthiness/neighbor preservation, graph and epoch state.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject dropping epochs, samples or edges, or using unseeded execution to get parallelism.

experiments.title: Fuse tree split statistics and candidate scoring
experiments.arm_a: Consume ordered histogram prefixes directly in score/tie selection without writing all intermediate prefix/score arrays.
experiments.arm_b: Separate prefix, gain and best-split kernels.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Same candidate set, prefix arithmetic, regularization, missing direction, score rounding and feature/threshold tie order.
experiments.quality_gate: Split sequence, leaf values, predictions and task quality, including categorical/missing inputs.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject register pressure, altered tie selection or fewer candidate thresholds.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Builds on I17 frontier scheduling; different pass-fusion hypothesis.

experiments.title: Exact histogram sibling subtraction
experiments.arm_a: Compute the smaller child and recover the sibling from retained parent exact integer/limb counts under proven range bounds.
experiments.arm_b: Build both child histograms independently.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Only exact bounded accumulators qualify; floating gradient sums require a distinct coordinated numerical profile and are not enabled by this card.
experiments.quality_gate: Histogram cells, split/leaf/model identity, overflow/refusal and sampled-feature semantics.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject unbounded parent retention or subtracting mismatched feature/row populations.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Reuse I18 implementation; extend applicability only with explicit accumulator proofs.

experiments.title: Tree frontier tasks by live work and histogram bytes
experiments.arm_a: Bucket independent node-feature tasks by rows and bounded histogram footprint, compacting inactive nodes and retaining stable logical node IDs.
experiments.arm_b: Uniform task geometry across a skewed frontier.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Scheduling cannot alter row membership, feature RNG mapping, split order or arithmetic partitions.
experiments.quality_gate: Tree structures and predictions for deep/skewed and broad trees, peak memory and task counts.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject descriptor overhead, uncontrolled frontiers or thresholds fitted to board dimensions.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Extends I17/A07/N07; attribute new geometry independently of existing candidates.

experiments.title: Stable tree partition fused with child bookkeeping
experiments.arm_a: Use one stable flag/scan/scatter to produce child row indices, counts and offsets; avoid separate metadata and redundant row scans.
experiments.arm_b: Independent partition and child-statistic bookkeeping passes.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Stable original row order within each child, exact offsets, missing direction and overflow handling.
experiments.quality_gate: Child row lists, sampled weights, all descendant splits and public model words.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject unstable atomics or consuming partially published offsets.

experiments.title: Batch independent forest construction with logical RNG IDs
experiments.arm_a: Share immutable training tiles among bounded independent tree tasks; key random draws by existing tree/node/draw identities.
experiments.arm_b: Build one tree at a time with repeated input staging.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Keep bootstrap, feature sampling, random thresholds and forest output tree order fixed; no worker-completion-order RNG.
experiments.quality_gate: Per-tree structures, OOB state, predictions and anomaly scores across seeds.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject memory multiplied by forest width or an implicit reduction-order change in forest averaging.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: I18 multi-tree frontier was still open; distinguish construction from inference batching.

experiments.title: Packed forest inference and fixed tree-output reduction
experiments.arm_a: Compare structure-of-arrays node storage and bounded row/tree tiles, retaining a fixed logical per-row tree accumulation order.
experiments.arm_b: Incumbent model layout and per-tree traversal schedule.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: No threshold quantization or leaf compression changing values; preserve missing/categorical branches, class order and averaging arithmetic.
experiments.quality_gate: Decision paths, leaf IDs, scores/probabilities and predict outputs; unbalanced depths and repeated/cold use.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject model repacking cost hiding in untimed setup or altered reductions across tree batches.

experiments.title: TreeSHAP shared path metadata and bounded batching
experiments.arm_a: Reuse immutable path/cover metadata and batch independent row/tree explanations while reducing contributions in canonical tree order.
experiments.arm_b: Reconstruct path metadata and issue per-row/tree work separately.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Exact SHAP semantics, repeated-feature path unwinding, zero covers and bias contribution retained; no approximate SHAP substitution.
experiments.quality_gate: All contribution words across vendors, additivity residual, interactions if supported and zero-cover behavior.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject exponential scratch growth or change to feature attribution semantics.

experiments.title: Versioned stable pair-combine KDE reduction
experiments.arm_a: Represent each fixed reference tile by (maximum,scaled_sum) and combine pairs with portable exp/log in a declared tree, sharing distance/kernel work.
experiments.arm_b: Incumbent chunked log-sum-exp fold and temporary layout.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: New host/device profile includes -Inf/empty tiles, zero contributions, rescaling order and tail carry; same metric, kernel and bandwidth.
experiments.quality_gate: Log-density accuracy, held-out likelihood, extreme bandwidths and all supported kernels/metrics; no quality regression.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject extra exponentials, overflow or silently dropping small nonzero contributions.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: I20 schedule work exists; this is its separate arithmetic-profile proposal.

experiments.title: GMM reusable centered tiles and fused sufficient statistics
experiments.arm_a: Share centered tiles/responsibility reads across independent component statistics with bounded batching; separate each fusion from component stacking.
experiments.arm_b: Reread/recenter inputs for each statistic/component.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Keep responsibility normalization, covariance fold, regularization, empty-component policy and first convergence state; changed statistic fold requires its own version profile.
experiments.quality_gate: Likelihood, iterations, weights/means/covariances/precisions and predictions; all covariance types and near singularities.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject recreating the documented AMD E-step stacking loss or cheaper iterations that increase full-fit time.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Reuse I21 centered-load/fusion work and retained loser evidence.

experiments.title: GP factor and batched prediction reuse
experiments.arm_a: Retain fitted kernel/factor state for grouped mean/variance RHS tasks and reuse shared kernel tiles across independent class/hyperparameter evaluations.
experiments.arm_b: Rebuild/reupload factors or compute mean and variance kernel tiles separately.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Hyperparameters, exact/variational model choice, jitter/pivot policy and optimizer trial selection unchanged; caches invalidate on theta or training-data changes.
experiments.quality_gate: Predictive means/variances, log marginal likelihood, gradients, probabilities and calibration.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject replacing exact GP with sparse approximation or timing only mean when variance is requested.

experiments.title: Naive Bayes class-statistic pass fusion
experiments.arm_a: Reuse canonical label grouping and input loads across counts/means/centered moments, emitting only required fitted statistics.
experiments.arm_b: Separate class and feature scans and intermediate arrays.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Integer counts exact; weighted floating moments use the same fixed partition or an explicitly versioned common profile. Smoothing and prior semantics unchanged.
experiments.quality_gate: Counts, means/variance, log probabilities and predictions; absent classes, zero counts and partial_fit where supported.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject raw-moment variance cancellation or double-applying smoothing during reuse.

experiments.title: Discriminant class solves and prediction fusion
experiments.arm_a: Batch independent class factorizations/solves and share prediction input tiles with fixed per-class quadratic forms.
experiments.arm_b: Per-class staging, launch and centered intermediate matrices.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Same covariance, shrinkage, priors, factor/rank thresholds and quadratic-form fold; class batching changes scheduling only.
experiments.quality_gate: Fitted factors, decision values, posterior probabilities, accuracy and singular-class refusals.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject changed rank truncation or posterior normalization.

experiments.title: Robust covariance candidate state reuse
experiments.arm_a: Reuse immutable row tiles across independent robust-subset candidates and batch candidate covariance/distance work; retain canonical subset selection.
experiments.arm_b: Repeated full staging/scans for each candidate.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Seeded subset membership, C-step update order, support-size settings, determinant ties and reweighting unchanged.
experiments.quality_gate: Location, covariance, support, distances, anomaly labels and robust objective.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject fewer trials, changed contamination/support fraction or a covariance shortcut that degrades robustness.

experiments.title: Batch independent classical forecast candidates
experiments.arm_a: Schedule independent series and parameter trials in bounded tasks, sharing immutable observations and retaining scalar recurrence order within a series.
experiments.arm_b: Per-series/trial dispatch and repeated observation transfers.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Only classical forecast callers; no neural sequence code changes. Preserve first selected trial, initialization, recurrence arithmetic and convergence.
experiments.quality_gate: Likelihood/SSE, selected parameters, fitted states, forecasts and forecast errors; short and ragged seasonal series.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject changed search grid or fewer optimizer trials.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Use I23 independent-work infrastructure; do not duplicate existing forecast arms.

experiments.title: ARIMA device-resident order and likelihood trials
experiments.arm_a: Retain differenced observations and independent likelihood trial states, batching supported order/trial evaluations with deterministic acceptance selection.
experiments.arm_b: Recreate or transfer immutable preparation per trial and poll each independent evaluation.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Order search sequence, AIC/BIC ties, likelihood/Kalman arithmetic, stationarity constraints and optimizer stopping unchanged.
experiments.quality_gate: Chosen orders, coefficients, innovations, likelihood and forecast quality; singular/refused candidates.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject approximate Kalman covariance, skipped orders or unsupported device features.
experiments.relationship_to_existing: Follow-up to I23 batching; profile-changing affine scans remain separate future work.

experiments.title: Reuse classical stationarity preparation and lag work
experiments.arm_a: Share canonical detrending/differencing buffers and lagged product tiles across requested tests/lags, fusing independent scalar report work.
experiments.arm_b: Recompute each preparation and rescan series per test/lag.
experiments.arithmetic_contract: Same test definitions, lag selection, trend, null, critical-value interpolation and differencing stopping; FAST code only informs storage scheduling.
experiments.quality_gate: Statistics, p-values, selected lags/differencing order and downstream forecast quality.
experiments.rejection_conditions: Reject truncated series, changed lag caps or altered critical-value policy.
